channel.title: First Home Money
channel.description: A plain-language guide to the costs and paperwork of buying a first home.

item.title: Debt-to-Income Ratio for a Mortgage, Explained
item.description: Lenders compare your monthly debt payments with gross income before approving a mortgage. Here is how to calculate DTI and what it means.

item.title: Fixed vs Adjustable-Rate Mortgages in Plain Words
item.description: A fixed rate never changes; an adjustable rate resets using an index plus a margin. See how an ARM adjusts, with payment math on a $300,000 loan.

item.title: Closing Costs, Item by Item
item.description: A line-by-line walkthrough of a mortgage Closing Disclosure using official CFPB definitions, so each charge is easier to recognize.

item.title: Costs to Expect Before Buying a First Home
item.description: A plain-language rundown of mortgage-related fees and charges first-time buyers often miss, based on official CFPB guidance.

item.title: Mortgage Pre-Approval vs Pre-Qualification, According to the CFPB
item.description: What prequalification and preapproval letters actually guarantee, how lenders use the terms differently, and why the label matters less than you think.

item.title: Private Mortgage Insurance, When It Actually Comes Off
item.description: The federal rules that require your lender to cancel PMI automatically, plus a worked example of when that happens on a typical 30-year loan.
